# The call statements of cmd/server main() and of internal/api.NewHandler, in
# source order, from the syntax tree (refactor plan §6.4 S4a; invariants I10
# and I17). Written by TestBootSteps (cmd/server/boot_steps_test.go, which
# gives the rules in full); regenerate with
#   UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./cmd/server -count=1 -run '^TestBootSteps$'
#
#   call X       an expression statement calling X (a chain lists each call,
#                innermost first), a call assigned only to blank identifiers,
#                or a call of which an error result is kept, whatever else
#                it keeps (a call keeping only other results is no step)
#   go, defer    a go or defer statement: with X, it starts X; without, the
#                steps of the code it starts follow, indented
#   defer.inner  a defer in an inlined function, run when that one returns
#   inline F     F's own steps follow, indented (internal/api.NewHandler)
#   value v      a call of the function value in variable v
#   (T).M        method M called on a receiver of static type T; after an
#                AddSubscriber or Subscribe*, its arguments' static types
#   if, else, switch, case, default, for, select
#                blocks with a step inside, by nesting, without conditions
#
# Package-level functions of cmd/server, the a.<stage>() methods of its
# wire_*.go files and closures bound to a variable are inlined where a
# statement calls them, and so are internal/api's functions and *Handler
# methods inside NewHandler; a call an inlined function returns counts as made
# by the statement that called it. Calls into log and log/slog are left out.
# No file name, line number, argument or condition appears: moving code
# between files, into helpers or into stages leaves this file as it is;
# moving a step past another one changes it. Being arguments, timer and
# ticker durations (the purge's 24 h, the reaper's first tick at 30 s) are
# not pinned here.

func main()
  defer value stop
  call internal/domain/orgs.SetSelfHosted
  call internal/domain/orgs.SetDefaultPlan
  call (*internal/config.Config).DeploymentLimits
  if
    call os.Exit
  call internal/domain/orgs.SetDeploymentLimits
  call os.MkdirAll
  if
    call os.Exit
  call internal/persistence/postgres.Connect
  if
    call os.Exit
  defer (*database/sql.DB).Close
  call internal/persistence/postgres.MigrateAndBackfill
  if
    call os.Exit
  call internal/persistence/postgres.RunBootTaskOnce
  call (*internal/domain/links.DefaultService).SetArtifactService
  call (*internal/domain/artifacts.DefaultService).SetLinkSuspector
  call (*internal/domain/artifacts.DefaultService).SetEmbeddingIndexer
  call (*internal/domain/templates.DefaultService).SeedDefaults
  call (*internal/config.Config).GrandfatherBefore
  if
    if
      call os.Exit
    call (*internal/domain/orgs.DefaultService).GrandfatherBefore
    if
      call os.Exit
    call internal/domain/orgs.SetTiersEnforced
  call (*internal/domain/workerkeys.DefaultService).SetPairingRepository
  if
    call internal/domain/hostedworkers.Reconcile
  if
    call (*internal/domain/orgs.DefaultService).EarliestPersonalOrgID
    if
      call (*internal/domain/workerkeys.DefaultService).EnsureBootstrapKey
  call (*internal/domain/exports.DefaultService).SetProductService
  call internal/seeds.EnsureSharedProductPool
  call (*internal/domain/exports.DefaultService).SetAttributeService
  call (*internal/domain/downloads.DefaultService).SetEvidenceSource
  call (*internal/domain/downloads.DefaultService).SetWorkspaceSource
  call internal/domain/agents.NewFileService
  if
    call os.Exit
  call (*internal/domain/agents.FileService).SyncAllFromDisk
  call (*internal/domain/agentruns.DefaultService).SetRoutingPolicy
  call (*internal/domain/agentruns.DefaultService).SetRetryPolicy
  call (*internal/domain/teams.DefaultService).SetMemberValidator
  call (*internal/domain/proposals.DefaultService).OnResolved
  call (*internal/domain/orgs.DefaultService).ListAll
  if
  else
    for
      call internal/seeds.EnsureOrgDefaults
  call (*internal/domain/agentruns.DefaultService).AddSubscriber(*internal/metrics.Metrics)
  call (*internal/domain/agentruns.DefaultService).AddSubscriber(*internal/api.SSEHub)
  call (*internal/metrics.Metrics).WatchSSEConnections
  call (*internal/domain/agentruns.DefaultService).AddSubscriber(*internal/orchestration.Hooks)
  call (*internal/orchestration.Hooks).SubscribeBus(*internal/events.DefaultBus)
  call (*internal/domain/users.DefaultService).SetEmailVerificationPolicy
  call (*internal/domain/users.DefaultService).SetSessionPolicy
  call internal/notify.NewNotifier -> (*internal/notify.Notifier).SetChannels -> (*internal/notify.Notifier).SetOrgService -> (*internal/notify.Notifier).SetUserNamer -> (*internal/notify.Notifier).Start
  call internal/notify.NewBudgetMonitor -> (*internal/notify.BudgetMonitor).SetChannels -> (*internal/notify.BudgetMonitor).Start
  call internal/domain/release.NewService
  if
    go (*internal/notify.ReleaseAnnouncer).Announce
    call internal/notify.NewStableScheduler -> (*internal/notify.StableScheduler).SetChannels -> (*internal/notify.StableScheduler).Start
    if
      call internal/notify.NewSupportWindowWatcher -> (*internal/notify.SupportWindowWatcher).SetChannels -> (*internal/notify.SupportWindowWatcher).Start
  if
    call (*internal/domain/agentruns.DefaultService).SetBudgetGuard
  call internal/automation.NewTriggerMatcher -> (*internal/automation.TriggerMatcher).Start
  call internal/scheduler.New -> (*internal/scheduler.Scheduler).Start
  go
    call (*internal/domain/orgs.DefaultService).PurgeExpired
    for
      call os.Remove
    for
      call (*internal/domain/agents.FileService).RemoveOrg
    defer (*time.Ticker).Stop
    for
      select
        case
          call (*internal/domain/orgs.DefaultService).PurgeExpired
          for
            call os.Remove
          for
            call (*internal/domain/agents.FileService).RemoveOrg
  go
    defer (*time.Ticker).Stop
    for
      select
        case
          call (*internal/domain/agentruns.DefaultService).FailStale
          call (*internal/persistence/postgres.UserRepository).DeleteExpiredSessions
          call (*internal/persistence/postgres.UserRepository).DeleteSpentEmailVerifications
          call (*internal/persistence/postgres.UserRepository).DeleteSpentPasswordResets
          call (*internal/domain/invitations.DefaultService).PurgeExpired
          if
            call (internal/domain/runnersessions.Service).Sweep
  call (*internal/config.Config).Billing
  if
    call os.Exit
  switch
    case
      call (*internal/billing.Service).SetUsers
      call (*internal/billing.Service).SetPortalConfig
      call (*internal/billing.Service).SetTrialDays
      call (*internal/billing.Service).SetMaxSeats
      if
        call (*internal/billing.Service).SetReturnURL
      call (*internal/billing.Service).Start
  inline internal/api.NewHandler
    if
      call (*internal/billing.Service).SetSeatCounter
      call (*internal/billing.Service).DefaultReturnURL
    call conversion to int64
  call (*internal/domain/proposals.DefaultService).SetAppliers
  call (*internal/orchestration.Hooks).SetGuidedNudgeLauncher
  call (*internal/api.Handler).RegisterRoutes
  call (*github.com/gorilla/mux.Router).Handle -> (*github.com/gorilla/mux.Route).Methods
  call (*internal/api.AuthMiddleware).SetPoolKey
  call (*internal/api.AuthMiddleware).SetEmailVerificationPolicy
  if
    call (*internal/api.AuthMiddleware).SetActivityRecorder
  call internal/api.CORSMiddleware
  if
    call os.Exit
  go
    call (*net/http.Server).ListenAndServe
  select
    case
      if
        call os.Exit
    case
      call value stop
      defer value cancel
      call (*net/http.Server).Shutdown
      if
        call (*net/http.Server).Close
